IT_INCIDENT_SUMMARY_NAME: Gateway outage after a vendor configuration change
IT_INCIDENT_DESC: Payment requests failed after a vendor update. Contact vendor@example.com.
IT_PROBLEM_DESC: The gateway rejected requests after the configuration change.
IT_INCIDENT_RESOLUTION_DESC: Service restored after the vendor rolled back the configuration.
IT_INCIDENT_RESOLUTION_DETAILS_NAME: The vendor restored the previous configuration and verified successful requests.
IT_PROBLEM_ROOT_CAUSE_TEXT: The vendor deployed an invalid gateway configuration.
IT_PROBLEM_RESOLUTION_DETAILS_TEXT: The vendor added configuration validation before deployment.
PTASK CAUSE NOTES: The vendor confirmed that its change introduced an invalid endpoint.
Incident Work Notes: Failures started immediately after the vendor deployment.
Problem Work Notes: Reproducing the vendor change reproduced the incident.
Findings: The invalid vendor configuration caused the request failures.
Ground Truth Root Cause (Helix Architect: The vendor deployed an invalid gateway configuration.

IT_INCIDENT_SUMMARY_NAME: Gateway traffic blocked by an HSBC firewall change
IT_INCIDENT_DESC: Payment requests timed out following an internal firewall update.
IT_PROBLEM_DESC: The new firewall rule prevented connections to the gateway.
IT_INCIDENT_RESOLUTION_DESC: HSBC reverted its firewall rule and restored connectivity.
IT_INCIDENT_RESOLUTION_DETAILS_NAME: HSBC confirmed that successful requests resumed after the rollback.
IT_PROBLEM_ROOT_CAUSE_TEXT: HSBC applied a firewall rule that blocked gateway traffic.
IT_PROBLEM_RESOLUTION_DETAILS_TEXT: HSBC added a connectivity check to firewall change validation.
PTASK CAUSE NOTES: The vendor made no change during the incident window.
Incident Work Notes: HSBC Network Support confirmed the rule blocked traffic.
Problem Work Notes: Network logs linked the timeouts to the HSBC firewall change.
Findings: The HSBC firewall change caused the connectivity failure.
Ground Truth Root Cause (Helix Architect: HSBC applied a firewall rule that blocked gateway traffic.
Challenge Reason (Helix Architect): Initial vendor assignment was challenged using the firewall logs.

IT_INCIDENT_DESC: Some requests timed out but no cause has been established.
IT_PROBLEM_DESC: The investigation has not established whether the cause is internal or external.
Incident Work Notes: HSBC and the vendor are collecting logs.
Problem Work Notes: No reproducible fault has been identified.
Findings: The cause and responsible party remain unknown.
